text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me.
Would it be alright if we stopped by somewhere?
There's a place nearby I frequent."
choice_data_list: Of course, sure. What kind of shop is it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"These are hand-baked rice crackers.
My grandparents love them, so I want to send some over."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Soy sauce, sesame, coarse sugar... and seven-spice chili, too.
The jumbo value pack, please.

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Coming right up! The usual for you too, Believe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Two bags each of soy sauce, seaweed, sesame, coarse sugar,
and yuzu pepper, please.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, mister~
Give me the usual too, please~"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, Sky-san.
Do you two come here often as well?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
You two are regulars here! 
I'm making some bonus senbei right now.
Come on in, have some tea, and wait!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "What a coincidence. To think you were all sending these rice crackers to your grandparents as well."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Hand-baked rice crackers are apparently hard to come by in America.
I'm sending some along with a letter.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, by letter.
That's pretty rare nowadays, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
My grandfather doesn't own a smartphone.
He says having a phone is plenty enough.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san's grandfather too, huh?
Mine is as well. You could say he's old-fashioned..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What a contrast. My grandpa's already got
electronic money totally figured out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes she'd play shogi online with me.
There was even a time we did it while both out fishing~"

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sounds like you can do all sorts of things with them. My grandkid's been nagging me non-stop to buy a smartphone too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
They were explaining how it can do this and that,
but I didn't understand a damn thing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"It's really convenient once you get the hang of it~
Though that also makes it a bit complex and tricky."

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Studying at this point is impossible for me.
Oops, the rice crackers are done baking.
Here, Trainer, have one!
choice_data_list: Thank you very much, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...Just like my grandfather, I thought a phone call was enough. But—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
My grandmother has been sending me
messages on LANE lately.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Someone I met in America taught me.
I did my best to write a short message using only hiragana.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I wish I could have taught them.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I wanted to teach you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
America and Japan...
Now that they are so far apart... it's difficult.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We've ended up staying for quite a while, haven't we? Thank you for the meal, Master.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Um... would it be all right if I took a video
of you grilling the rice crackers?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: An acquaintance of my grandfather from America learned that the rice crackers are hand-baked, and apparently wants to see the process.

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind, but... can smartphones really send videos all the way to America?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner's Grandchild
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I explained it to you yesterday!
Jeez, you really weren't listening at all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, could you be the grandchild I've heard rumors about?

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, okay?
Apps and, what is it, "Lanes"?
It's all total gibberish to me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Still... maybe I'll get the hang of it if I look at the real deal.
...So, explain it to me one more time, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner's Grandchild
text_block_list.text:
! I see... That makes sense.
Then let's go look at smartphones together♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Cracker Shop Owner's Grandchild
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you all the latest features!
Like biometric authentication—Grandpa, you definitely need to master this!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ho, heading straight for the shop. Looks like a guaranteed purchase.
Your grandchild doesn't mess around.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I must speak with my grandfather once more.
The wave of digitalization is simply unavoidable, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What about the people around you, Trainer?
Do they feel like they've got a handle on their smartphones?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I often keep in touch with my family and hometown friends
on my smartphone. For example—
choice_data_list: I told Believe about her next race.
I've been told to come show my face

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Stories... about me?
choice_data_list: Everyone is paying attention to your race.
Everyone's paying close attention to your race.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. My races are
the fruition of your work, Trainer, so...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, you just want people to cheer for her, right? For Believe, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......
Then, I will answer your expectations—with solid, dependable work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Just to show my face...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I realized that just like me, Trainer,
you're someone's grandchild and child too...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It just felt... a bit mysterious to me.
I'm sorry.
